Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager

Interface Connector

All Known Implementing Classes:
AndroidConnector, PostgresConnector, SQLiteConnector
public interface Connector
Builds the Connection, query factory and schema builder of one kind of database.

A DatabaseManager holds one connector per driver name and asks it to build a connection the first time a configured connection with that driver is used. Each database module supplies its own connector; the core has no driver dependency.

Implementation Requirements:
Implementations must be safe to call from several threads, for different configs at once. They must not put a password in a URL, an exception message or a log line. The manager calls connect(org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager.ConnectionConfig, javax.sql.DataSource) at most once per connection until that connection is purged.

  • Method Details

    • driver

      String driver()
      Returns the driver name this connector serves.
      Returns:
      the name matched against ConnectionConfig.driver(), never null or blank

    • connect

      Connection connect(ConnectionConfig config, DataSource dataSource)
      Builds a connection for a config.

      When the connector needs a resource that outlives the call, such as the anchor connection that keeps an in-memory database alive, it keeps the resource and releases it in close(Connection).

      Parameters:
      config - the connection config, never null
      dataSource - the data source the user registered for this connection, or null when the connector must build its own from the config
      Returns:
      the connection, never null
      Throws:
      DatabaseConfigException - if the config lacks a key this driver needs

    • close

      default void close(Connection connection)
      Releases what connect(org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager.ConnectionConfig, javax.sql.DataSource) kept for a connection, once the manager drops it.

      The manager calls this on purge, disconnect and close, before it closes a data source the user registered. The default does nothing.

      Parameters:
      connection - the connection connect(org.aristonis.diwan.database.manager.ConnectionConfig, javax.sql.DataSource) returned, never null
